intro.title: Connect Your Shop Floor, Data and Decisions
paragraphs: Many plants still run on spreadsheets, paper inspection sheets and disconnected systems. Managers find out about delays, defects and machine breakdowns hours or days too late, and nobody has one reliable view of production, stock and quality.

We build custom manufacturing software that brings it together: production planning and execution, quality management and inspection, inventory and warehouse control, preventive maintenance, supply chain visibility and real-time IoT dashboards. Everything connects with your ERP and machines, so data is captured once and used everywhere.

Whether you run one plant or many, we design systems around your products, processes and people. See our <qri>QRI Dashboard for quality inspection</qri>, explore our <stock>stock management software</stock> or <contact>talk to us about your plant</contact>.

faqs.title: Manufacturing Software Development FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers for plant heads, operations and IT teams.

items.a: It is building software for manufacturers, such as production planning and execution, quality management, inventory, maintenance, supply chain and IoT dashboards, tailored to their processes.

items.q: Can manufacturing software integrate with our ERP?
items.a: Yes. We integrate with your existing ERP and accounting systems so production, inventory and quality data flows automatically without double entry.

items.q: Can you connect our machines for real-time monitoring?
items.a: Yes. Using PLC data, sensors and edge gateways we bring machine output, downtime and condition data into live dashboards and alerts.

items.q: Do you build quality inspection software?
items.a: Yes. Our QRI Dashboard digitises inspections with checklists, defect photos, approvals and real-time quality metrics by line, shift, batch and SKU.

items.q: How much does manufacturing software cost?
items.a: A single module typically costs $5,000 to $20,000, a plant operations suite $20,000 to $80,000, and multi-plant platforms $80,000 or more.

items.q: Will the software work on the shop floor with poor connectivity?
items.a: Yes. We design tablet and mobile apps that keep working offline and sync when the network is available.
